figure.caption: The five elements of a cohort study in order, with the entry checks that gate the cohorts at selection. Live-case entries illustrative.

items.title: Select subjects
items.text: From the general population, or from special groups that can be studied readily.
items.entry: The plant's own workforce, from its records

items.title: Record exposure
items.text: Each member lands in the exposed or unexposed group for a stated reason.
items.entry: 5 or more years of tank cleaning

items.title: Choose comparison
items.text: Little or no exposure, but otherwise similar.
items.entry: Other men at the same plant

items.title: Follow up
items.text: Both groups under the same identical conditions.

items.title: Analyse
items.text: Incidence in each group, then the relative risk.
